subject: Leadership snapshot: OKR alignment and support gap list for go-live
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@stargazer.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership snapshot: OKR alignment and support gap list for go-live

Team / Acme,

Quick leadership snapshot ahead of tomorrow's QBR prep window. Attached are a short slide deck and a tracking sheet listing identified gaps across GTM, enablement, pricing, docs, and support. High-level summary: 

- GTM: Sales playbook finalized; need one final pricing confirmation for tiered discounts. (owner: Marissa)
- Enablement: Training modules ready but not scheduled; need two trainer slots and recorded session plan. (owner: Karthik)
- Documentation: API reference is complete; quickstart and migration notes need sign-off. (owner: Monica)
- Support readiness: Runbook draft exists; we have three unknowns in escalation routing and on-call coverage. (owner: Vivek)

Asks: 
1) Review the attached leadership snapshot deck and the support_gap_register.xlsx by EOD tomorrow. I highlighted the OKR checkpoints tied to the launch: M1 (adoption), M2 (latency SLOs), M3 (cost/unit).
2) Marissa — confirm final pricing tables and whether procurement needs an SOW/contract template from Acme.
3) Karthik — pick two candidate dates next week for train-the-trainer sessions; attach the rollout plan if available.
4) Monica — push final quickstart to the internal docs review board and flag any remaining missing examples.
5) Vivek — confirm the on-call rota and escalation owners; where there are gaps mark them in the support register.

Meeting proposal: 2027-05-27 16:00 PT 30min for leadership QBR prep; propose to include Acme (Sarah/procurement) for the mutual action plan section. If that works I will send the calendar invite.

Attachments: leadership_snapshot_QBR_slide_deck.pdf (12 slides), support_gap_register.xlsx (1 sheet)

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@stargazer.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership snapshot: OKR alignment and support gap list for go-live

Ben — thanks for the concise snapshot. Quick notes from leadership perspective: 

- OKR alignment: We need explicit success criteria for M1/M2/M3. Please add one-sentence acceptance criteria next to each OKR in the deck.
- Risks: The pricing confirmation is the highest external blocker; if procurement needs a template or a timeline we should surface that today.
- Escalation: If support on-call gaps persist, we must fund temporary coverage for the first two weeks post-launch — mark as possible contingency in the budget ask.

Action items I want captured before the prep meeting: 
• Owners and due dates next to each line item in the support_gap_register.xlsx
• A one-page mutual action plan (MAP) for Acme that we can share during the QBR (Ben/Marissa)
• A short runbook appendix showing primary/secondary escalation flow (Vivek/Karthik)

I can join the 2027-05-27 16:00 PT slot. If Acme needs earlier, suggest we do a 15-minute touch on 05-26.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
VP, GTM Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@stargazer.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership snapshot: OKR alignment and support gap list for go-live

Thanks — adding details on enablement and the runbook. Attaching the rollout plan; highlights below.

Enablement highlights (from enablement_rollout_plan.docx):
- Week 0: Trainer enablement (2 half-days) + recorded baseline session (owner: Karthik)
- Week 1: Customer-facing webinars (2 x 45min) + office hours (3 sessions)
- Week 2: Embedded support shadowing + closed-loop feedback on docs

Needs/Blockers: 
- Pricing confirmation to finalize trainer scripts (Marissa/Procurement). If pricing tiers change we must update the usage examples and billing FAQ.
- API migration example: we need one customer migration example from Acme to include in quickstart (Monica/Sarah).

I propose train-the-trainer slots on: 2027-06-01 09:00 PT or 2027-06-02 13:00 PT — please confirm.

Attachment: enablement_rollout_plan.docx

Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Developer Enablement, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@stargazer.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership snapshot: OKR alignment and support gap list for go-live

Ben/Team — appreciate the clear list. Procurement asked me to confirm two things: 
1) A proposed pricing table for initial committed capacity and burst options so procurement can prepare PO terms.
2) A draft MAP (mutual action plan) they can circulate internally to speed approvals.

We can do a 15-minute touch on 2027-05-26 15:00 PT if that helps resolve pricing questions before the longer QBR prep. I can also provide a migration example — our integrations team can record a short screencast by Friday if that is helpful to Monica.

Sarah
Customer Success, Stargazer / Acme Analytics
sarah@stargazer.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@stargazer.ai>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership snapshot: OKR alignment and support gap list for go-live

Folks — thanks for the rapid responses and helpful commitments. Final plan and next steps: 

- Marissa: finalize pricing table and send to procurement by EOD 05-26 (if delayed we push the 15:00 PT touch to 05-27 09:00).
- Karthik: confirm training slot — leaning toward 2027-06-01 09:00 PT; please confirm by 05-28.
- Monica: accept the migration screencast from Sarah and fold into quickstart; update docs board by 05-28.
- Vivek: add escalation owners and on-call coverage to support_gap_register.xlsx by 05-28.
- Laura: I will prepare the one-page MAP for Acme and circulate draft this evening; will add one-line acceptance criteria to the deck.

I will send the 30-minute QBR prep invite for 2027-05-27 16:00 PT and a 15-minute pricing touch invite if Marissa/procurement request it. Please update the trackers and the drive links as you complete items.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
